game: Card Run CRASH 20× (launch build, batch 3; run-bar v170: CASH OUT / DOUBLE OR NOTHING / DOUBLE HALF; minimum run $0.02; RUN IT AGAIN and RUN HALF removed)

runbar_show_keys: half >= MIN_RUN && B + keep + 2 * half <= MW

small_amounts.note: run-bar v170: the minimum run is $0.02 (DOUBLE OR NOTHING from a held $0.02, DOUBLE HALF from $0.04). A double is exact (no rounding); only the LOCK IN offers of DOUBLE OR NOTHING round down to the cent. Small = held $0.02-$0.99, reported apart from $1.00 and up.

policy_definitions.build lock1: LOCK IN at red #1 (pays 0.93x bet, always reached)
policy_definitions.build auto: never tap LOCK IN: AUTO DEAL runs to the top red (#18, 20.63x) or a bust
policy_definitions.P0: CASH OUT at the first run bar
policy_definitions.P1: RETIRED (was RUN IT AGAIN once; removed with the ride in v170)
policy_definitions.P2: DOUBLE OR NOTHING once, played out (no LOCK IN), then CASH OUT
policy_definitions.P3: DOUBLE OR NOTHING while it is shown (until the 1,000x run cap, MAX WIN, or a bust), then CASH OUT
policy_definitions.P4: random: at every bar CASH OUT w.p. 1/3, else a uniformly random shown run button (DOUBLE OR NOTHING / DOUBLE HALF); LOCK IN w.p. 1/3 at each race card
policy_definitions.P5: DOUBLE HALF once (half doubles, played out; the other half and any odd cent go to the RUN BANK; a lost double brings the RUN BANK back as the bar: CASH OUT), then CASH OUT. NEW definition (v169: RUN HALF once)
